label_order: Command-Only (Runs When You Ask — No Switch Needed)
Always On (Core Safety Rule — Cannot Be Turned Off)

labels.Switchable / Adjustable (Typed & Setting: A real switch or choice: type it or change it in Settings.
labels.Settings-Only (By Design — Security Boun: Changed only on the PC Settings page, never by typing (credentials, restore backup) — a security boundary by design.
labels.PC-Only Setting (Honest Refusal on Phone: A setting/ability that exists on one app only today; the other app honestly refuses rather than faking a control.
labels.Command-Only (Runs When You Ask — No Swi: No switch exists: you ask and Jarvis runs it (or it is a read-only info page).
labels.Always On (Core Safety Rule — Cannot Be: No off switch by design: a core safety rule that always stays on.
